senses.gloss: c. (μάλαγμα) any emollient, plaster, poultice. Sifra B’har ch. I (ref. to Lev. XXV, 6) ולא לעשות ממנה מ׳ but not to use (the fruits of the Sabbatical year) for a poultice; Succ. 40ᵇ; B. Kam. 102ᵃ.
units: Tosef. Dem. I, 25 קמח לעשות מ׳ flour to make poultices; a. fr.—Trnsf. a soothing remedy.
<cite ref="Shabbat 119b:4">Sabb. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>חמין … מ׳</he> hot water after the exit of the Sabbath is soothing.
